items.where: 548: white stone frontispiece over the middle bay, ground to cornice (53.0-56.7 m along the front), pilaster strips either side
items.how: stone slab with two proud pilaster strips

items.where: 548: the hotel entrance, panelled door under a round-headed fanlight in a stone surround, on a stoop with iron railings (door 1.7-4.6 m, fanlight to 5.9 m)
items.how: church-kit door() with a round fanlight and stone surround on the frontispiece, a cornice hood; stoop() with iron rails; the radiating fanlight bars are not modelled

items.where: 548: scrolled cartouche over the cornice carrying two coats of arms side by side (top about 20 m)
items.how: extruded cartouche outline with disc-and-ring side scrolls, two shields in red and green and a crowning lump; the charges of the arms are not drawn

items.where: 548: attic balustrade over the console cornice (16.6-17.7 m) either side of the cartouche, urns on both corners
items.how: lathe balusters between posts, plinth and rail; lathe urns on pedestals

items.where: 548: small iron balcony over the door on the frontispiece (6.7 m)
items.how: stone slab with plain iron posts and rails; the scrolled ironwork pattern is not modelled

items.where: 548: the hotel flag on a raked pole from the frontispiece at the first floor
items.how: one plain dark burgundy flag on a pole at 45 degrees; no logo

items.where: 548: house number plate by the door; no hotel name lettering readable on the front

items.where: wall lanterns either side of the doors of 556, 554 and 548
items.how: bracket, glass box, pyramid cap

items.where: 554: white stucco Louis XIV front, five bays, three storeys, modillion cornice (15.0-15.8 m)
items.how: 0.3 m stucco skin on the block, white-framed sashes with small panes, cornice with modillions

items.where: 554: plaster festoons over the bel-etage and first-floor windows and drop ornaments between the middle bays
items.how: strings of flattened spheres hanging between two rosettes over each window, long drops on the piers; the leaf modelling is not carved

items.where: 554: small iron balcony over the door at the first floor, on a cornice hood with consoles (7.0 m)
items.how: stone slab and hood on two consoles, plain iron posts and rail

items.where: 554: balustrade over the cornice (15.8-17.0 m) either side of a raised middle panel
items.how: lathe balusters between posts; the middle panel with a relief tablet

items.where: 554: sculpture group on the middle of the attic (figures round a cartouche, top 18.7 m)
items.how: a group of stretched spheres on the attic panel giving the outline of the reclining figures; no faces or limbs

items.where: 554: urn on the east corner of the attic (17.0-18.0 m)
items.how: lathe urn on a pedestal

items.where: 550-552: two neck dormers on the cornice line with claws, pediment crowns and hoist beams (16.0-19.2 m)
items.how: neck-gable.ts neckGable() at dormer scale, window, hoist beam, slate cheek roof

items.where: 550-552: white cornice on paired consoles (14.0-16.0 m), dark glazing bars in seven bays
items.how: frieze, crown moulding and paired consoles over every pier

items.where: 546: white frontispiece with the door under an oculus (5.3-6.3 m), cornice hood, rectangular windows over it; segment-headed windows in the brick bays
items.how: stone slab with pilaster strips, dark door, ring and glass disc oculus, hood; win() segment heads elsewhere

items.where: 546: stoop with a white stone balustrade
items.how: landing and flight with square stone balusters under a raking rail

items.where: 546: white dormer over the frontispiece (15.8-18.2 m)
items.how: gabled stone dormer box set back in the roof with its window and a slate saddle; the dormer pediment mouldings are not modelled
